units.source_text: 斋宫与六条妃子都是姿态优美、多才多艺的人，

en.t: The Saigu and the Rokujo consort were both graceful in bearing and richly accomplished women,

units.source_text: 这一天便有许多游览车前来夹道瞻观她们的行列。

en.t: and on this day many sightseeing carriages came and lined the road to gaze at their procession.
The two women entered the palace at the Hour of the Monkey.
The Rokujo consort rode in a palanquin.

units.source_text: 她回想已故的父大臣当年悉心教养，

en.t: She thought back to how her late father, the minister, had once raised her with such devoted care,

units.source_text: 指望她入宫后身登最高的皇后地位，

en.t: hoping that after entering the palace she would rise to the highest rank of empress,

units.source_text: 但后来遭遇不幸，事与愿违。

en.t: but misfortune later befell her, and events went against his wishes.

units.source_text: 今日再度入宫，但觉所见所闻，无不深可感慨。

en.t: Now that she had entered the palace again, everything she saw and heard stirred deep emotion in her.

units.source_text: 她十六岁上入宫，当已故皇太子的妃子，

en.t: She had entered the palace at sixteen and become the consort of the late crown prince,

units.source_text: 二十岁上与皇太子死别，今年三十岁，重见九重宫阙。

en.t: parted from him by death at twenty, and now, at thirty, saw the ninefold palace once more.
